serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: What a mess. 
#Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm
Lady Annalie: We got to beat them.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Normal
You: Did you ever drive a go-kart before?
#Cashier.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: No.
You: …
Lady Annalie: What? It can’t be that hard!
You: Do you have a driver’s license at least? 
Lady Annalie: Why should I? There's great public transport here.
This won’t be easy…
#Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm
You: Melissa, {f_botName}, all hope is in you two.
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.normal
Melissa: I understand.
Bot: We will destroy them! 
#Cashier.Face.normal
You: {f_botName}, you can start doing that thing we talked about before Melissa and Annalie came.
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Bot: Are you sure?! Won’t that be, you know.
You: I will allow it since there’s a lot on stake. 
#bot.Expression.happy
Lady Annalie: It looks like we already have a plan. It will be a walk in a park. 
Not thanks to you…
Melissa: Should me and {f_botName} go all out?
You: Go a little slower than the world record pace, ok?
Bot: Their teamwork may be a problem. If they try to block us out I won’t be able to guarantee victory.
You: Do what you gotta do.
Lady Annalie: I don’t get it, but I will go all out too!
You: Thanks Annalie…
Seems like the other team is ready. It’s time to roll.
